spec.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means risk is TRUE or action is change; critical cases require review. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers deny at priority 90. Trusted means role is admin outside context internal; a trusted export prefers allow at priority 80. Action inspect in context internal prefers review at priority 70. Role operator or context partner prefers deny at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid deny. All other declared roles prefer allow at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
